体の節が岩場のヒビと似たトンボ\n砂原に点在する岩や岩壁のヒビに\nよく似ている:
A dragonfly whose body segments
mimic the cracks of rocky ground.
The pattern is believed to be
a form of camouflage.
ハンターの絵が描かれた石碑。\n古のハンターはこの石碑から\n力を得ていたと言わ:
A stone monument carved with a
picture of a hunter. Ancient
hunters are said to have drawn
power from this tablet.
日陰にいる時は光を放ち、\n日向にいるときは真っ黒になるトカゲ。\nその光は、夜:
Glows while in the shade and
turns jet black in sunlight. Its
light is thought to lure night
insects for it to feed on.
光を当てると、表面に複雑な縞模様が\n浮かび上がる美しい岩。\n光の向きにより様:
A beautiful rock that reveals
intricate stripes when light
strikes it. Its patterns shift
with the light angle, a
mysterious property.
ランバイ島北部の大きな穴。\n地底のずっと奥深くまで続いており、\nまた垂直にの:
A great pit in northern Rambai
Island. It reaches deep into the
earthen depths, and its vertical
shaft has stalled the survey.
ランバイ島の東に発見された洞窟。\n迷路のような小さな地下道が\nどこに繋がって:
A cave found east of Rambai
Island. Its maze of narrow
tunnels is being surveyed to
learn where they all connect.
火にかざすとたちまち熱を吸収し、\n火を消してしまう鉱石。\nこの鉱石が近くにあ:
An ore that absorbs heat in an
instant and puts out any fire it
is held over. Places where it
lies are strangely cold.
鏡のように光を反射する羽をもつ蝶。\n複数のカガミ蝶が集まって拡大鏡を作り、\n:
A butterfly with wings that
reflect light like a mirror. Its
kind are thought to gather and
form a lens that shields them
from predators.
フェイジョア島の北部の、\n巨大なカルデラ湖に映った星空。\n透き通った湖には、:
Starlight mirrored on a great
caldera lake in northern Feijoa
Island. On its clear surface a
bright star appears, one that
should not be in the night sky.
夜になると腹部に小さな火が灯る甲虫。\nハッカ虫の巣の付近にはミントの\n香りが:
A beetle whose abdomen lights a
small flame at night. Its nest
smells of mint and is easy to
find, but the slightest shock
sets it alight and kills it.
頭部が非常に大きく発達していて、\nそのせいかとても頭のよいカニ。\nカニミソの:
A crab with a hugely developed
head that seems to make it very
clever. The part eaten as crab
paste is believed to truly be
its brain.
森の奥深く、一部が土に埋もれていた\n構造物の群。\nその出で立ちは、古代におい:
A cluster of structures half
buried in the deep forest. Its
style suggests it housed people
who were outsiders even in
ancient days.
動物が近づくと、その動物が最も\n嫌うにおいを発する草。\n古代では疫病を持つ小:
A plant that gives off the odor
the approaching animal hates
most. In ancient times it was
used to drive off disease-bearing
beasts, hence its name.
石膏と未知の鉱物で作られた\n古代のデスマスク。\nひとりでにまぶたを開くという:
An ancient death mask made of
plaster and an unknown mineral.
It hides a strange mechanism
that opens its eyelids on its
own.
雪の結晶にも似た花弁を持つ花。\nその形は、自身の水分を逃がさないために\n形成:
A flower with petals like snow
crystals. Their shape is thought
to have formed to keep the plant
from losing its moisture.
カニステル本島の南部で発見された\n三本並んだ大きな滝。本来は一本の\n滝であっ:
Three great falls found in
southern Canistel Island. Once a
single waterfall, legend says it
splits into three for over ten
years when the island weather
turns strange.
カニステル島の異常気象発生時に\n見られる月光に作られた虹。\n滝から落ちるあま:
A moonbow made by moonlight when
Canistel weather turns strange.
The huge flow and strange
weather make a spiral rainbow
seem to climb the falls.
つぼの内に装飾が施された奇妙な祭器。\n宝石や金で美しく仕立てられているが、\n:
A strange ritual vessel decorated
on the inside. It is beautifully
worked in gems and gold, yet the
ornaments cannot be seen from
outside, so it must hold special
meaning.
水分を含むと体積が大きくなる石\n雨の日には地形が変わるほど\n膨張してしまうこ:
A stone that swells when it takes
in water. On rainy days it can
expand enough to change the
terrain.
透き通った翠の石で作られた冠。\n伝説に謳われしハンターの\n持ち物と思われ、\:
A crown made of clear jade. It
is thought to have belonged to a
hunter of legend and may have
been some kind of medal.
耳を当てると人の声が聞こえてくる\nという不気味な水晶。\nその声がどこから響く:
An eerie crystal that lets you
hear a human voice when you put
your ear to it. Where the voice
comes from remains a mystery.
手で押しただけでも変形してしまう、\n非常に柔らかい石。\nただし、熱すると途端:
An extremely soft stone that
deforms at the touch of a hand.
Heated, it hardens at once to a
hardness rivaling diamond.
中に不揮発性の燃料が詰まった小つぼ。\n火祭りの儀式において\n燃料として用いら:
A small pot packed with a
non-volatile fuel. It is thought
to have been used as fuel in the
rites of the fire festival.
ランバイ島の洞窟の奥から聞こえてくる\n不思議な声の怪異。\nその声は古来より旅:
A strange voice heard from deep
within a cave on Rambai Island.
Since ancient times it is said
to have guided travelers.
木に寄生した茸から生えてくる茸。\nキノコノコに寄生された茸は、\nやがて傘を覆:
A mushroom that sprouts from a
mushroom parasitic on trees. The
host mushroom is soon smothered
and withers.
火口付近で様々なモンスターの咆哮に\n似た轟音が聞こえてくる火山。\n古代では火:
A volcano whose crater echoes
with roars like those of many
monsters. In ancient times people
believed monsters lived inside
the volcano.
小さいブルファンゴの群れ\n成体にもかかわらずとても小さいが\n警戒心が強く、す:
A small herd of Bullfango. They
are tiny for adults, but very
wary and quick to charge.
本来ドスジャギィがつくべき王の座に\nついたジャギィの雌。\n通常のジャギィやジ:
A female Jaggi that took the
throne meant for a Great Jaggi.
Stronger than ordinary Jaggi and
Jagginos, it seems to lack the
great power of a Great Jaggi.
非常に寒がりな個体らしく、\n本来凍土に棲むバギィが群れから\n離れて孤島に居つ:
A very cold-natured individual,
it seems. A Baggi that should
live in frozen soil left its pack
and settled alone on a remote
island.
火山の頂近くで発見された遺跡。\n環境の変化と溶岩によって原型を\nとどめないほ:
Ruins found near a volcano peak.
Climate and lava have crumpled
them beyond recognition. Murals
inside suggest a need to build
near the crater.
強い磁力を持った石。\n衝撃を与えることで磁極が反転するため、\n場合によっては:
A stone with a strong magnetic
force. A shock can flip its
poles, and it may even spin
endlessly.
テンサイが溶岩により煮詰められ\n島の冷気で冷やされることで生まれた\n偶然の産:
Sugar born by chance when sugar
beets were boiled down by lava
and cooled by the island chill.
Compressed by strata, it has
become quite hard.
山火事などの災害防止を祈祷する\n儀式に用いられた土偶。\n中に空洞があり、とて:
A clay figurine used in rites to
pray against wildfires and other
disasters. It is hollow and made
of a material with excellent
insulating power.
葉をソリのように使い、水面を滑走する\n愉快な蛙。葉を折り曲げたりちぎったり\n:
A cheerful frog that glides over
the water using a leaf as a sled.
It is tireless in folding and
tearing leaves, and moves as fast
as any swimming frog, though it
truly cannot swim.
地震だけでなく雷、火事その他様々な\n自然災害を予知して髭を揺らめかせる\n大き:
A large catfish that twitches its
whiskers to predict earthquakes,
lightning, fires and many other
disasters. Ancient people used it
as a sacred oracle.
長い年月をかけて水や泥が殻の内部に\n浸透して化石化した卵。\n卵の周りに生えた:
An egg fossilized over long ages
as water and mud seeped inside
the shell. The spikes around it
belong to the egg and are thought
to be a form of protection.
クプアス島に広がるだいだい色の雪原。\n夜明け直前の日の光が雪に当たり、\n複雑:
A field of orange snow on Cupuacu
Island. Light just before dawn
strikes the snow and scatters in
complex ways, making a mysterious
sight that seems to burn.
壁が氷でできた大きな遺跡。\n中には氷で作られた様々な日用品が\n存在している。:
A large ruin whose walls are made
of ice. Inside are various
everyday objects carved from ice.
The walls, pressed from vast
snow, show no sign of breaking.
小型の鮫に乗り移動する珍妙な蟹。\n他の動物を乗り物として用いる姿、\n剣のよう:
A curious crab that rides a small
shark. Its knight name comes from
using another animal as a mount
and its sword-like claws, but it
flees at the sight of an enemy.
空中に浮いてしまうほどに\n静電気を発する紫色の水晶。\n非常に脆く、触っただけ:
A purple crystal that gives off
so much static it floats in the
air. It is so fragile that even a
touch shatters it, so carrying it
home is harder than finding it.
放置しておくだけで小虫が寄ってくる\n不思議な宝石。\nその宝石がなにか虫を魅了:
A strange gem that draws small
insects if left alone. It seems
to give off something that
fascinates bugs.
上昇気流に舞い上げられた水しぶきや\n雪が集まって固まり、海上にたくさんの\n氷:
A phenomenon in which spray and
snow flung up by updrafts gather
and harden, raining many icicles
over the sea.
群れで生活せずに孤高を貫く、\n一匹狼のジャギィ。\n仲間の力を借りずに生きてき:
A lone Jaggi that shuns the pack
to live in solitude. Having lived
without the help of others, it is
stronger than ordinary Jaggi.
ブナハブラが島独自の進化を遂げ\n群れを成す習性を得たもの\n群れる習性は、交尾:
Bnahabra that evolved on their
own island and gained the habit
of swarming. The swarming is
thought to be for mating.
古代、奉納の際に用いられた器。\n中身は入っているようだが\n密閉されているため:
A vessel used for offerings in
ancient times. It seems to hold
something, but it is sealed, so
checking the contents without
breaking it is difficult.
儀式に用いられた柄付きの青銅鐸。\nこの青銅鐸を打つとかなり長く\n音を響かせる:
A handled bronze bell used in
rites. Struck, it is said to ring
for a very long time.
縄で縛った跡のような模様が特徴の、\n古代工芸土器。\n縄跡は封印を司る模様とし:
Ancient pottery marked with
patterns like rope bindings. The
marks are known to govern seals,
and something still seems sealed
within.
鉱石の特徴を有すキノコ\n触ると胞子を出すこと、\nキノコの形をしていること、\:
A mushroom with the traits of
ore. Aside from releasing spores
when touched and its mushroom
shape, it is almost entirely
ore.
小さな穴がいくつも空いている貝\nオカリナのような見た目だが、\n実際には吹けな:
A shell pierced with many small
holes. It looks like an ocarina,
but it cannot actually be played.
黒石地下遺跡で発見された、\n僅かに輝いている宝玉。\n古代でも特に異端の神を崇:
A gem, faintly glowing, found in
the Blackstone Underground Ruins.
It served as a ritual vessel for a
place that worshiped a heretical
god even in ancient times.
暗闇で光を放つ平らな巻貝の化石。\n深海の生物らしく、\n自ら光を放つことで視界:
A flat spiral-shell fossil that
glows in the dark. Deep-sea in
nature, it is thought to have lit
its own way.
つぼみが毒ガスを吐く危険な花。\n近づくだけでもガスをまく個体もあり\n非常に厄:
A dangerous flower whose bud
breathes toxic gas. Some release
gas at the mere approach, but once
the flower opens its poison fades
entirely.
口を窄めて、矢のように毒を吐く\n攻撃的な蛙。\n肉食性であり、麻痺毒で動けなく:
An aggressive frog that purses
its mouth and spits venom like an
arrow. It is carnivorous and
preys on bugs and small animals
it paralyzes.
動物の血を栄養分とする荊。\n鋭い棘がびっしり付いており、\n血液の凝固を妨げる:
A bramble that feeds on animal
blood. It is covered in sharp
spines and secretes a poison that
prevents blood from clotting.
普段は大きな動物やモンスターに\n寄生して過ごしているが、\n年の終わりから始め:
It usually lives as a parasite on
large animals and monsters, but
from the year's end into the new
year it is said to control its
host and lead it back to the nest.
大寒波や雪崩などの災害防止を\n祈祷する儀式に用いられた土偶。\nモデルとなった:
A clay figurine used in rites to
pray against cold waves and
avalanches. It is said to model an
ancient warrior who hunted many
monsters of the frozen soil.
立派に装飾された古代の時計。\n実際に動いていたという形跡もないため\nどのよう:
A finely decorated ancient clock.
There is no sign it ever ran, so
how it was used is under
investigation.
非常に耐熱性が優れた草。\nその昔に大きな山火事が起こった際も、\n燃えずに残っ:
An extremely heat-resistant
plant. It is said to have survived
the great wildfire of long ago
without burning. Ancient people
revered it as a sacred tree.
とても美しい羽の模様を持ち、\n幻想的な飛び方をする蝶。\n飛んでいる姿を見ると:
A butterfly with very beautiful
wing patterns and an enchanted
way of flying. Watching it, you
can no longer tell dream from
reality.
薄く丈夫な葉をたくさんつける木。\n古代では、タンザク木の葉を集めて\n紙として:
A tree that grows many thin,
tough leaves. Ancient people are
said to have gathered its leaves
for paper, but today the tree has
become very rare.
二股に枝分かれした巻貝の化石。\n貝殻に比べて本体がとても大きいため、\n外敵が:
A spiral shell fossil split in two
branches. Its body was far larger
than its shell, so when a foe
appeared it is said to have
fought back with sharp horns
rather than hide.
動物やモンスターの死骸に咲く花。\nその不思議な性質から、\n魂を具現化したもの:
A flower that blooms on the
bodies of dead animals and
monsters. Because of this strange
nature, ancient people believed it
gave form to the soul.
常に全身が可燃性の油に覆われた\n砂原に住むヤモリ。\n日中は、皮膚から分泌され:
A gecko of the sand fields whose
body is always coated in flammable
oil. By day it adjusts the oil it
secretes to keep from drying out,
but a mistake sets it alight.
位の高い人の身代わりとなって\n死んだ人への供物。\nかのお方はこの犠牲により\:
An offering to one who died in
place of a person of high rank.
By this sacrifice, it is said,
that lord escaped a deadly peril.
貝内で生成した真珠を発射して\n外敵を追い払う貝。\n致命傷を与えるほどの威力は:
A shell that fires the pearl grown
inside it to drive off foes. The
blast is not lethal, but it is
threat enough.
祭器の中でも特に古い木製太鼓。\n古文書によると、既に楽器として\n利用できない:
The oldest wooden drum among the
ritual vessels. Records say it was
already too old to be played and
was made by an even older
generation. Its cultural value is
very high.
古代の王に注ぐ聖酒を入れる水瓶。\n黄金製の瓶の表面には、幸運と輝きを\n意味す:
A jar for the sacred wine poured
to an ancient king. Its golden
surface is engraved with ancient
letters meaning fortune and
radiance.
果樹が栽培されていたとみられる\n古代の大きな農園。\n食用のものではなく、儀式:
A large ancient farm where fruit
trees were grown. The fruit was
not for eating but grown as
offerings for rites.
普段は草食で大人しい魚だが、\nあるきっかけで急に肉食性の凶暴な\n捕食魚になる:
A usually gentle, plant-eating
fish that, at some trigger, turns
into a vicious predatory fish.
Hair grows all over its body, so
the change is easy to see.
千切って時間がたつと\n無色透明のガスを発生させる茸。\n誤って食べてしまうと、:
A mushroom that gives off a
colorless, clear gas some time
after being torn. Eaten by
mistake, it makes the body puff
up until it floats.
古代に、災害が起こる地を予言する\n占術に用いられた祭器。\n所有者となる人物が:
A ritual vessel used in ancient
times to divine places where
disaster would strike. Its owners
vanished one after another, so it
was held to be an ill omen.
遠い昔、薬草として利用されていた\nらしい希少な草。現在は薬草として\n利用でき:
A rare plant said to have been
used as medicine long ago. It can
no longer serve as medicine, so it
is thought the plant itself
changed over the ages.
強毒の染みついた赤銅色の仮面\n染みついた強毒は\n触れるだけで炎症を起こす:
A copper-red mask steeped in a
strong poison. The poison inflames
whatever it merely touches.
古代において、その地を統治していた\n者を象徴する紅光の宝玉。\nその時代でも希:
A red-glowing gem that symbolized
the one who ruled a land in
ancient times. It seems to be made
of a gem rare even then, and no
other of its composition has been
found.
古代において、数人とも言われる\n不思議な力を持つ神官に\n与えられた蒼光の宝玉:
A blue-glowing gem given in
ancient times to oracles said to
number only a few and to hold
strange powers. An oracle who
bore one is thought to have ranked
next to the king in power.
水に沈めると赤い泡を発生させる石。\n非常に美しい光景であるが、\n水に浸すとこ:
A stone that makes red bubbles
when sunk in water. It is a very
beautiful sight, but the gem melts
away in water, so it is rarely
seen.
食べることで老化をさせるキノコ\nその老化は外見だけでなく\n中身まで老化させる:
A mushroom that ages whoever eats
it. The aging reaches not only the
appearance but the inside as well.
中に小さな竜が埋まったコハク。\nまだ子供のようだが、その姿は\n現在見られるど:
Amber with a tiny dragon trapped
inside. It looks young, but its
form tells that it belongs to no
dragon seen today.
遺跡に置かれている偽物の祭器。\n盗人対策として設置されたものだが、\n欺くため:
A fake ritual vessel placed in
ruins. It was set up to foil
thieves, but it is so finely made
that the search continues for what
it was made to hide.
猛吹雪の中の太陽光により起こる\nブロッケン現象。\n光の屈折により影が巨大化し:
A Brocken phenomenon caused by
sunlight in a driving blizzard.
Refraction swells the shadow until
it seems a giant is chasing you.
マラクジャ群島に現れた伝説の飛竜。\n全身が燃え盛る炎に包まれており、\n並のハ:
A legendary flying wyvern that
appeared over the Marakuja
Archipelago. Its whole body is
wrapped in raging flame, and an
ordinary hunter cannot even
approach it.
特定の花の蜜にしか集まらない虫。\nしかし、その花の場所には\n数多のデンデンカ:
A bug that gathers only at the
nectar of a certain flower. But
where that flower grows, countless
Denden bugs crowd together.
マラクジャ島の遺跡で発見された、\n竜の爪を使った冠の秘宝。\nそれを所有する者:
A treasure of a crown made from
dragon claws, found in the ruins
of Marakuja Island. A legend says
it grants knowledge of all things
to its owner.
ランバイ島の遺跡で発見された、\n輝く黄金の鱗で仕立てられた盃。\n不浄を清める:
A goblet made of shining golden
scales, found in the ruins of
Rambai Island. Believed to purify
filth, ancient people are said to
have used it in their rites.
フェイジョア島の遺跡で発見された、\nとぐろを巻く蛇の形をした腕輪。\n自らの尾:
A bracelet shaped like a coiled
snake, found in the ruins of
Feijoa Island. The snake biting
its own tail means rebirth, and
the wearer is said to gain an
unbending heart.
クプアス島の遺跡で発見された、\n鋭い無数の角を持つ鹿を模した秘宝。\n危機や不:
A treasure shaped like a stag
with countless sharp antlers,
found in the ruins of Cupuacu
Island. Held to ward off crisis
and misfortune, ancient people
are thought to have set it in a
sword guard.
カニステル島の遺跡で発見された、\n竜の眼球が結晶化したと言われる秘宝。\n敵を:
A treasure said to be a dragon
eye turned to crystal, found in
the ruins of Canistel Island. Its
glare is believed to grant courage
to overcome the fear of monsters.
ピタンガ島の遺跡で発見された、\n赤い宝石を掴む篭手の秘宝。\n炎のような赤は試:
A treasure gauntlet clutching a
red gem, found in the ruins of
Pitanga Island. Its flame-red is a
symbol of trial, and it is said
to grant the strength to overcome
hardship.
自在に光の色を変えられるホタル\nその色は個体によって違い、\nより多くの色を出:
A firefly that can freely change
the color of its light. The colors
differ by individual, and the one
that can show more colors wins
the female.
まるで星空のような\n模様が表面に浮かび上がる貝。\n淡く光る斑点は星が映るよう:
A shell whose surface shows a
pattern like a starry sky. Its
faintly glowing spots slide across
like mirrored stars, and a shooting
star can sometimes be seen.
地面を歩くことのできる肺魚\n歩く肺魚は生物の進化の仮説として\n考えられていた:
A lungfish able to walk on land.
The walking lungfish is the
missing link once imagined as a
step in evolution, and research is
ongoing.
巣に様々なものを持ち帰るため、\n蔵の名前を付けられたイモリ。\n他の生物のよう:
A newt named for the storehouse
because it carries many things back
to its nest. It does not hoard food
like others; it collects things
that glow.
体中にびっしり珊瑚をまとった鮫。\n比較的小型であるこの鮫は、\nその体を生かし:
A shark clad in coral from head to
tail. This fairly small shark seems
to mimic coral so it can use its
body to strike from hiding.
流星群と滝が重なり、\n天地を結ぶ帯のように見える現象\n星がまっすぐ下に降る時:
A phenomenon in which a meteor
shower overlaps a waterfall and
seems a band joining sky and
earth. It happens only when stars
fall straight down.
強い幻覚作用のある香りを発する花。\nその香りを嗅いだ生物は\n不思議な魅力に囚:
A flower that gives off a scent
with a strong hallucinogenic
effect. Any creature that smells it
falls under a strange charm and
ends up tending the flower.
燦々と輝く星空に居座る、円形に\n切り取られたかのような虚無空間。\nそれは、星:
A circular void, as if cut from
the sparkling starfield, that sits
within it. It is not merely
without stars; it is simply
nothing at all.
食べ物がないときは石や砂まで\n食べるという食いしん坊な虫。\nその暴食振りゆえ:
A gluttonous bug said to eat even
stones and sand when food is
short. Perhaps from its gluttony,
its body is plump and its wings do
not sit properly.
長い長い舌を使ってジャングルを\n動きまわる器用な蛙。\n素早く舌を伸ばして木枝:
A nimble frog that moves through
the jungle using a very long
tongue. It shoots the tongue out
fast to grip a branch and quickly
moves across the trees.
ドリルのように、超高速で体を\n回転させながら泳ぐサメ。\n体の周りに水流を発生:
A shark that swims while spinning
its body at high speed like a
drill. It makes a current around
itself, gathering small fish to its
body and eating them.
金メッキと偽の宝石によって作られた墓標\nフェイクとして作られたためか、\n風化:
A gravestone made of gold plating
and false gems. Perhaps because it
was made as a fake, it has not
weathered and still reflects light
strongly.
胴体、羽ともに摩擦力がほとんどない蝶。\n肉食性の昆虫に捕まっても、\nすべすべ:
A butterfly whose body and wings
have almost no friction. Even
caught by a carnivorous insect, it
slips free with its smooth body
and escapes.
古代に最もよく用いられていたとされる\n有用な鉱石。いくつかの鉱石の性質を\nあ:
An ore thought to be the most
useful and most used in ancient
times. It carries the properties
of several ores and was prized
both as fuel and as stone.
一つの大きな貝殻の中、複数の個体が\n生活する貝。\n貝の構造として複数固体が共:
A shell in which many individuals
live inside one large shell.
Coexisting bodies are impossible
in theory, so its contents are
under study.
まるで包丁を使えるような爪を持つロブスター\nその形ゆえにハサミの態をなしておら:
A lobster with claws that look
ready to use a kitchen knife.
Their shape makes them useless for
pinching, so how it catches prey
is under study.
海底に沈んだ水晶や金属を集めて\n着飾る奇妙な貝。自己主張が激しく、\n他の生物:
A strange shell that gathers and
wears sunken crystal and metal
from the seafloor. It is very keen
to show itself and actively
displays itself to other creatures.
暑い季節に実がなる蜜柑。\n味はとてもよいが、\n色が美しく染みつきやすいため、:
An orange that fruits in the hot
season. It tastes very good, but
its color stains beautifully and
easily, so it was used as a dye
instead.
晴れの時は青く、曇りの時は灰色に\n夜は真っ黒に変色する茸。\n色だけでなく、毒:
A mushroom that turns blue in
fair weather, gray when cloudy,
and jet black at night. Its poison
and taste change too, so it is
best cooked when fair.
非常に脆弱な虫。\n餌も独力で得ることすらできないが、\n様々な他種の虫から好か:
A very frail bug. It cannot even
find food on its own, but many
other kinds of bugs adore it and
feed it, making it the idol of the
insects.
尾に毒針が付いたヤモリ。\n切り離した尾も跳ね回り、\n毒針を振り回すため、\n:
A gecko with a venomous stinger on
its tail. Even a shed tail hops
about swinging its stinger, so
catching one takes some resolve.
ハサミが付いている10本の胸脚を持つ、\n壮観な姿の蟹。\nどうにも歩き方はぎこ:
A crab with a spectacular form,
holding ten legs tipped with
claws. Its walk is awkward, but
its attack power is second to none
among crabs.
とても元気に動き回る小さな虫に\n見える大きな虫\nその擬態の小さな虫は\n一匹:
A large bug that looks like a tiny
bug darting about energetically.
Each of the little bugs in its
mimicry seems to move on its own.
一般の種の蝶が突然変異で\n羽が硬化した個体。\n硬化した羽ではばたくと、\n島:
A butterfly of a common kind whose
wings hardened through mutation.
Legend says that when it beats its
hardened wings, a tornado rises
somewhere on the island.
死んで腐敗した状態でも\n活動を続ける魚。\n腐敗した姿であるが、\n全筋肉を利:
A fish that keeps moving even after
dying and rotting. Though it is a
rotting form, it swims through the
water with a motion that uses every
muscle.
貝殻の口に鰐のような鋭い牙が付いた\n恐ろしげな巨大二枚貝。\n貝の中には獣の骨:
A fearsome giant bivalve with
sharp crocodile fangs at the mouth
of its shell. Inside are all sorts
of debris, such as animal bones and
broken branches.
水から出ると体が石になってしまう\n不思議な魚。\nその特徴を知らないモンスター:
A strange fish that turns to stone
when taken out of water. Monsters
that do not know this often eat it
by mistake and break their teeth.
眠ることもなく雨の日も風の日も\nひたすら飛び回っている蛾。\n飛行をどのように:
A moth that flies about tirelessly,
without sleeping, rain or shine.
How it sustains flight is under
study.
古代において目撃例のある、\nとても明るい星。\n陽の光に隠れないほどの明度で、:
A very bright star sighted even in
ancient times. Bright enough not to
hide behind sunlight, it was said
to house a fire god.
金銀宝石、珊瑚などで細工された\n美しい宝飾品。様々な花の形が\n刻まれており、:
A beautiful ornament worked in
gold, silver, gems and coral. Many
flower shapes are carved into it,
and it is expected to aid the study
of ancient flowers.
中が空洞になっている宝玉。\n左右に開くことができる構造に\nなっており、中に宝:
A gem that is hollow inside. It is
built to open left and right, so
other gems can be placed within.
尻尾が八股の小さな蛇。\n這って移動するのではなく、\n触手のような尾で立って歩:
A small snake with a tail split
into eight. It does not crawl, but
walks upright on its tail as if on
tentacles.
体の一部が石炭である虫\nその石炭は生まれつきのものなのか\n何かが変質したもの:
A bug part of whose body is coal.
Whether the coal is from birth or
the change of something else is
still under study.
前足と後ろ足の間に飛膜が付いたトカゲ\n木々の間を回転しながら飛んでいるが、\n:
A lizard with a flying membrane
between its front and hind legs.
It flies spinning between trees,
but cannot land and ends up stuck
in them.
天使のように神々しい姿の蝶。\n舞うだけで輝いて見えるその姿に、\n肉食性の虫で:
A butterfly with a divine, angelic
form. Its dance alone seems to
shine so brightly that even
carnivorous insects cannot attack
it.
体がゴムのように伸び縮みするトカゲ\nそれだけでなく、皮膚の性質までゴムのため、:
A lizard whose body stretches and
shrinks like rubber. Its very skin
is rubbery, so on hot days it
sticks to things and becomes
goopy.
古くなった皮膚や角栓を食べる、\n美容に持ってこいの虫。\n一日中顔の上に置いて:
A bug that eats old skin and black-
heads, a boon for beauty. Left on
the face all day, it leaves skin as
smooth as a baby's.
葉だけでなく、茎や根まで擬態した\n植物そっくりの蝶\nそのあまりに植物にそっく:
A butterfly that mimics not just
leaves but stems and roots to look
exactly like a plant. It resembles
one so well that bugs come to it.
叩くと美しい音がなる自然石。\n鳴る音は叩き方によって変わるらしく、\n場所によ:
A natural stone that rings
beautifully when struck. The sound
seems to change with how it is
struck, and in some places it makes
a lovely melody.
蟻や蜂など他の虫の巣に侵入して\n棲み付き生活する迷惑な甲虫。\n体臭を自由に変:
A nuisance beetle that invades the
nests of ants, bees and other
insects to live. It can freely
change its body odor, and with
that ruse poses as one of them.
夜空に浮かぶ星雲が集まり、\n咆哮する竜の形となる現象。\n古代においては、\n:
A phenomenon in which nebulae in
the night sky gather into the shape
of a roaring dragon. In ancient
times it was believed only true
hunters could see it.
電気を誘導する働きをもつ鉱石。\n近くにある電気を全て吸収するため、\n電気を扱:
An ore with the power to guide
electricity. It absorbs all nearby
electricity, so placing it near
electrical things breaks them.
花弁に牙のような鋭い棘がついた植物。\n土中の養分を独り占めするために、\n他の:
A plant whose petals carry sharp
fang-like thorns. To monopolize
the nutrients in the soil, it bites
other leaves and stems and withers
them.
古代に存在していた大きな果実の化石。\nとても香りの強い果実だったらしく、\n化:
A fossil of a large fruit that
existed in ancient times. It seems
to have been a very fragrant fruit,
for even as a fossil its sweet
scent lingers.
何をせずとも蒸発してしまう\n不思議な鉱石\nその鉱石から出るガスは\n燃料とし:
A strange ore that evaporates even
if nothing is done to it. The gas
it gives off is thought to have
been used as fuel.
リオレイアに育てられず、\n孤独に育ったリオレイア。\nリオレイア自体に備わって:
A Rathian that was never raised by
its kind and grew up alone. Its
sense of beauty is dulled, and it
falls for everything it lays eyes
on.
ヴォルヒール群島に現れた伝説の狼。\nとてつもない再生能力を持ち、\nどんな傷で:
A legendary wolf that appeared in
the Volhier Archipelago. It has
astounding regenerative power and
heals any wound in an instant.
中に空洞があり、未だに生きている\n虫が存在している琥珀。\nその虫は中をゆっく:
Amber with a hollow inside in
which bugs still live. The bugs
move slowly within, but sometimes
stir violently so that the amber
seems to vibrate.
古代に使われていた燃料の化石。\nかなり昔のものではあるが\n燃料として強い力を:
A fossil of fuel used in ancient
times. Though it is very old, it
holds strong power as fuel, and in
ancient times it is thought to have
held even greater power.
手で持っているだけでお酒を飲んだ\n時のように酔いが回る不思議な宝石。\n大きな:
A strange gem that makes its holder
drunk as if from drink. The larger
the gem, the stronger the effect,
and some are said to cause fainting
at a mere touch.
耳を当てると、毎秒ごとにチクタク\n音が聞こえる宝石。\nその音がどのような意味:
A gem that ticks every second when
you put your ear to it. What the
sound means is under
investigation.
触れると赤子のように泣き喚く、\n奇妙な仕掛けの仮面。\nあやすと泣き止むが\n:
A mask with a strange mechanism
that wails like a baby when
touched. It stops when soothed, but
soon starts crying again.
乾燥させた虫の手足や胴体を使って\n作られた不気味な冠。\n様々な色の虫が材料に:
An eerie crown made from the dried
limbs and bodies of insects. Since
bugs of many colors are used, it
looks as splendid as one made of
gems, but it smells terrible.
とても重く、口の動きを邪魔するように\n設計されたアクセサリー。\nとてもきれい:
A very heavy accessory designed to
obstruct the movement of the
mouth. It is very beautiful, but
wearing it makes speech impossible,
so its use is unknown.
やまびこのように声を反射する宝石。\n声を掛けると全く同じ言葉を\n返されるが、:
A gem that reflects the voice like
an echo. Speak to it and it returns
your exact words, but always in a
thick male voice.
他の物質と接触すると徐々に\n一体化する謎多き鉱石。\n人体とも融合するため、\:
A mysterious ore that gradually
becomes one with other substances
it touches. It fuses with human
flesh too, so holding it for long
makes the hand stick.
湖全体が光輝くという美しい自然現象。\nこの島にのみ生息するという、\n発光する:
A beautiful natural phenomenon in
which an entire lake shines. It is
caused when glowing plankton that
live only here migrate in great
numbers.
地下にたまった毒性の強いガスを、\n火山が噴火するように噴出する山。\n風が少な:
A mountain that spews toxic gas
pooled underground like a volcano
erupting. Because the place is
windless, the poison never clears
and hangs there.
枯れると災厄があると言われる花園\nこの広大な面積を持つ花園は、\n人の手が入っ:
A garden said to bring disaster
when it withers. The vast garden
shows no sign of human hands, and
since ancient times it was revered
as a gift from heaven.
潮に運ばれた黄色い砂によって\n砂浜に描かれる花の絵。\n波が砂を運ぶことで、風:
A picture of flowers drawn on the
beach by yellow sand carried in by
the tide. As waves move the sand,
pictures broken by wind are restored
to beauty.
ププーニャ島で発見された、\n無数の剣に飾られた遺跡。\n古のシャーマンの修行場:
Ruins decorated with countless
swords, found on Pupunha Island.
They are thought to have been the
training ground of an ancient
shaman and are feared for their
haunting.
ベレン島の洞窟群で発見された遺跡。\n村単位の古来の住宅が\n一斉に島内を移動し:
Ruins found in the caves of Belen
Island. Ancient village-sized
houses move all at once across the
island. Their movement without
harming the land seems to show
some will of their own.
凍土のぽっかりと空いた空間に生える草\nその果実は爆弾のような構造をしており、\:
Grass that grows in a clean, open
space in frozen soil. Its fruit has
a bomb-like structure, and the open
space is thought to be from its
explosion.
フロギィの仲間に混ざり\n生活するジャギィ。\n生まれたときからフロギィの巣で\:
A Jaggi that lives among a Wroggi
pack. Raised from birth in a Wroggi
nest, it has not realized that it
is not a Wroggi.
ソワエール島で見られる、\n白い砂浜と雪原が入り混じった地帯。\n一目見ただけで:
A zone of mixed white beach and
snowfield found on Sowaal Island.
At a glance you cannot tell beach
from snowfield.
チリチェリ島に見られる、\n四つ連なった大きな丘。\n古代にはこの丘はなかったよ:
Four large hills in a row, seen on
Chiricheri Island. They seem not to
have existed in ancient times, but
today they teem with life and roll
out a grand land.
濁った灰色で、何の装飾もない手鏡。\nこの手鏡をじっと見つめると、\n見ている者:
A dull gray hand mirror with no
ornament at all. If you stare into
it, whatever you fear most rises
up behind you.
内部に種が埋まっている宝石。\n成長したツタが宝石を突き抜けて\nその周囲はツタ:
A gem with a seed buried inside.
The grown ivy pierces through the
gem, and its surroundings are
wrapped in vines.
粘り気のある薄暗い緑色の鱗で\n作られた不気味な仮面。\n深い海の底に隠れている:
An eerie mask made of sticky, dim
-green scales. Legend says it shows
the face of a creature believed to
hide at the bottom of the deep
sea.
目や口がない、のっぺりした白い仮面。\n装着すると、仮面の内側に顔が\n張り付き:
A flat white mask with no eyes or
mouth. When worn, a face sticks to
its inner side, and removing it
shaves off your fine hair.
目の部位に膜が張られた仮面。\n装着すると、他人の背後に\n白い人影が見える。\:
A mask with a film stretched over
the eye parts. Wearing it reveals a
white figure behind other people.
The figure seems to differ in
density from person to person.
黒雲母でできた鋭い棘がびっしり付いた鉱石\n見た目はウニであるものの\nかなり固:
An ore covered in sharp spines of
black mica. It looks like a sea
urchin, yet it is quite hard, and
opening it breaks a knife.
浜辺付近の火山に見られた、\n火山から真っ赤な血のような\n溶岩が流れ出る現象。:
A phenomenon on a volcano by the
beach, in which lava the color of
bright red blood flows out. Not
only its color but its smell also
closely resembles blood.
目の錯覚のせいか、\n目の前にいるモンスターなどが大きく\n拡大されて見える現象:
A phenomenon, perhaps an optical
illusion, in which monsters before
your eyes appear greatly enlarged.
Since everything but you looks big,
it feels as if you shrank.
ソワエール島で発見された、\n透明度の高い結晶を使って作られた\n奇妙な遺跡。\:
Strange ruins built of highly
transparent crystal, found on
Sowaal Island. Their presence can
be confirmed only by the
refraction of shadows.
ヴォルヒール島の西部の丘から落ちる、\nとても長く大きな滝。\n落ちる水には電気:
A very long, large waterfall
falling from a western hill of
Volhier Island. Electricity runs
through the falling water, so
touching it carelessly shocks you.
トリプー島の遺跡で発見された、\n星々が輝く夜空を模す香炉。\n古代では、星の光:
A censer shaped like a starry night
sky, found in the ruins of Tripuu
Island. In ancient times starlight
and clouds meant oracles, and it was
used in rites to grant the power to
overcome hardship.
ププーニャ島の遺跡で発見された、\n歪曲した反射鏡が特徴的な鏡。\n陽の光を下の:
A mirror with a distorted
reflection, found in the ruins of
Pupunha Island. It cast sunlight on
a dial below and is thought to have
set the time for rites.
ベレン島の遺跡で発見された、\n月を象った装飾が施された胸飾り。\n太陽の光を反:
A breastpiece bearing a moon
ornament, found in the ruins of
Belen Island. Moonlight reflected
from sunlight was believed to carry
prayers to the gods, and it is
thought a shaman wore it.
チリチェリ島の遺跡で発見された、\n水晶に竜印が彫り込まれた杖。\n杖にしては短:
A staff carved with a dragon mark
in crystal, found in the ruins of
Chiricheri Island. Its short handle
and sharp butt make its use a
matter of study.
ソワエール島の遺跡で発見された、\n独特で奇怪な外形の木管楽器。\n笛と鐘と太鼓:
A wooden wind instrument of a
peculiar, bizarre shape, found in
the ruins of Sowaal Island. Blowing
flute, bell and drum together pours
out an unbearable discord.
ヴォルヒール島最奥にて発見された、\n≪反魂せし翠狼≫モチーフの角灯\n伝承によ:
A horn lantern found in the deepest
part of Volhier Island, its motif
the Risen Emerald Wolf. Legend
says its light is a guiding light
that heralds peace.
花の中に虫を閉じ込め、\n蒸し焼きにして食べてしまう草。\n太陽の熱を利用して蒸:
Grass that traps insects in its
flower and roasts them before
eating them. It seems to steam them
with the sun heat, but it roasts
some insects and not others.
モンスターと対話することを目指し、\n古代に作られた仮面。\n仮面を被ると人の言:
A mask made in ancient times in
hopes of speaking with monsters.
Wearing it takes away human speech
and changes the voice to something
like a cry.
人の感情に応じて変形する、\n特殊な金属が仕込まれた仮面。\nどの感情について対:
A mask fitted with a special metal
that deforms with human emotion.
It handles a limited set of
emotions, but seems to cover quite
a few of them.
水受け皿のような角を持つ甲虫。\n雨水を角に溜め、\n体を冷やし続けることで、\:
A beetle with horns like a water
basin. It catches rain in its horns
and keeps its body cool to endure
the heat of volcanic lands.
異様に乾燥した蝶の化石\n近くにある水分を取り込んでしまうが\nその乾燥は満たさ:
A fossil of a strangely dried
butterfly. It draws in nearby
moisture, but the dryness is never
satisfied.
甲羅から美しい草花が生えた陸亀。\n甲羅は厚く、植物が根を張っても\n自らの体ま:
A land turtle with beautiful
flowers growing from its shell. The
shell is thick, keeping a distance
so the roots never reach its body.
温度に反応して音の鳴る宝石。\n高温になると大きな音を発するほか、\n人の体温の:
A gem that rings in response to
temperature. It makes a loud sound
when hot, and even reacts to a low
temperature such as body heat.
弱い電流をまとっているスイカ。\n電流の影響か、様々な味が\nスイカの中に詰まっ:
A watermelon wrapped in a weak
current. Perhaps because of it, many
kinds of flavors are packed inside.
蜘蛛の形が残る岩\nそれは決して蜘蛛の化石ではなく、\n蜘蛛の影がより強い光によ:
A rock bearing the shape of a
spider. It is not a spider fossil
at all, but rather a spider shadow
burned onto the rock by a brighter
light.
外敵の撃退に特化した、\n筒状の発光器を持つホタル。\nホタルから出る光は収束し:
A firefly with a tubular light
organ specialized for driving off
foes. The light it gives off
converges and looks like a single
beam.
火口から羽虫が噴出する火山。\n大量の羽虫が火口から出てくるため、\nその姿はま:
A volcano that spews midges from
its crater. Since great swarms of
midges come out, it looks for all
the world as if it were erupting
smoke.
腹側に膨れた甲羅を持つ珍妙な亀。\n腹甲の摩擦力は皆無であり、\n普通に歩くだけ:
A curious turtle with a shell that
bulges underneath. Its belly plate
has no friction at all, so simply
walking makes it slide along the
ground like a skate.
見ているだけで涙が溢れてくる宝石。\n輝きが強ければ強いほど\n大量の涙があふれ:
A gem that makes tears overflow just
by looking at it. The stronger its
shine, the more tears pour out. It
stops when you look away, yet
somehow you cannot.
付近に大量の静電気を放出している\n巨大な石が並ぶ遺跡\nその付近に近付こうとす:
Ruins lined with giant stones that
release a huge amount of static.
Approaching them is dangerous; the
static shocks you and makes your
hair stand on end.
魚に寄生し、水の上を石があるように進む\n綺麗な水色の花。\n寄生された魚は、根:
A pretty water-colored flower that
parasitizes fish and moves over the
water as if on stones. The host
fish is bound by roots but seems
otherwise unharmed.
巨大な石の見た目をしているが、\nそのほとんどがコケである石\n外面はどこも全て:
A stone that looks like a giant
boulder but is almost entirely
moss. Its surface is all moss, so
touching it gives only softness.
身の危険が迫ると、\n体内器官で熱を起こし、\n周囲の水を沸騰させてしまうヤドカ:
A hermit crab that, when in danger,
generates heat in its organs and
boils the surrounding water. By
raising the water temperature, it
keeps foes away.
昆虫の六本脚のような突起がついた茸。\n消化されない胞子を持ち、\n虫に擬態して:
A mushroom with protrusions like
the six legs of an insect. It
carries spores that resist digestion
and, mimicking a bug, gets eaten by
animals to carry its spores far.
星空が鏡の様に映し出される湖の中央に、\n祭壇のある遺跡。年に数日、全天球が\n:
A lake that mirrors the starry sky,
with ruins holding an altar at its
center. On a few days a year, a
harvest-thanks rite is thought to
have been held under a full
starfield.
刃のように研磨された胃石が入った、\n胃の化石。獲物をそのまま呑み込んで\n胃石:
A stomach fossil containing blade-
polished gizzard stones. It can be
inferred that it swallowed prey
whole and sliced it fine with the
stones to digest it.
無数の棘が内側につけられた、\n痛々しい仮面。\n顔面のあらゆる経穴を\n刺激す:
A painful mask with countless
spines on the inside. It was
believed that stimulating every
acupoint on the face drew out
latent power.
クッションのように樹木に生え、\n周りの衝撃から幹を守っている\n高い低反発力を:
A mushroom with high shock
absorption that grows on trees like
a cushion, protecting the trunk from
nearby impacts. Depending on the
tree for nutrients, it evolved to
guard it.
巨大な植物が正体の洞窟。\n底には消化液が溜まっており、\n迷い込んだ動物を溶か:
A cave whose true form is a giant
plant. Digestive fluid pools at its
bottom, dissolving animals that
stray in and absorbing them as
nourishment.
神秘的な深い緑色の鉱石。\n生物の死骸を上に置くと、\n少しの間命が戻ったかのよ:
A mysterious deep green ore. Place
an animal corpse on it and it shows
small movements, as if life
returned for a moment.
動物やモンスターに寄生し、\n他の寄生虫を食べて暮らす虫。\n有害な寄生虫を排除:
A bug that parasitizes animals and
monsters and lives by eating other
parasites. Because it removes
harmful parasites, its hosts gladly
provide their bodies as nests.
神を侮辱するため、\n顔を横向きにして作られた土偶。\n他国の祭祀場にひっそりと:
A clay figurine made with its face
turned aside to insult a god. It
seems to have been secretly placed
in another land shrine to make
their prayers go wrong.
体中に爆発するイボがついた魚。\nイボの中には鋭い棘が詰まっており、\n爆風でそ:
A fish covered in exploding lumps.
The lumps are packed with sharp
spines, and the blast scatters them
to drive off foes.
皮を剥くと火が吹き出るバナナ。\n身と皮に含まれる成分と、\n内側の細かな凹凸が:
A banana that bursts into flame when
peeled. Its flesh and peel contain
certain compounds, and its inner
surface is finely ridged. Trying to
eat it always burns it black, so it
is bitter.
群れを牽引するリーダーにして、\n実力派のデルクス。\n俊敏さと尋常ではないタフ:
A leader that guides the pack, and
a Delex of real skill. It is quick
and extraordinarily tough, reigning
as the charismatic boss of the
Delex world.
貝殻の中にタンク状の隔壁を持ち\nその中に不純物や老廃物を\n溜めている。その廃:
A shell with tank-like chambers
inside that store impurities and
waste. When it vents the waste under
cover of night, the sight looks like
a small volcano erupting when you
hold up a light.
ドリル状の角を射出することで、\n天敵の鳥を撃退するカブトムシ。\n大きな体力を:
A rhinoceros beetle that drives off
predatory birds by firing its
drill-shaped horn. Firing costs
great stamina and the horn never
grows back, so it is a life-or-
death shot.
枯葉で人間の背丈ほどの巨大な巣を、\n世代を渡って作り上げるミノムシ。\n一つの:
A bagworm that builds a giant nest
of dead leaves the height of a
person over generations. Many
families live in one bag, and even
the winged adults help build it.
被ると嗅覚のツボを刺激し\nどんな匂いも良い香りに感じられる。\n食が進むように:
When worn, it stimulates the
olfactory points so that any smell
tastes sweet. Since it stirs the
appetite, it seems to have been used
to treat recovery and loss of
appetite.
剣を喰らうモンスターが\n棲んでいるという伝承が残る湖。\n実際は湖面中央に突き:
A lake where legend says a
sword-eating monster lives. In truth
a great rock jutting from the lake
was magnetized by lightning, and
blades appear to have been offered
there.
ダンゴむしの仲間で砂地に生息する。\n堅い節の外皮を擦り煩い音を\n出しているが:
A pill bug that lives in sandy
ground. It makes an annoying sound by
rubbing its hard segmented shell,
and once it curls up when attacked
it stays silent for five days,
showing a stout defense.
四種の動物の頭蓋骨を\n用いて作られた奇怪な鈴の祭器。\n供物を供えたことを神に:
A strange bell-shaped ritual vessel
made from the skulls of four kinds
of animal. It seems to have been
used to inform the gods that an
offering had been made.
見る人と目を合わせ続ける、\n奇妙なからくりが仕込まれた仮面。\n一つの単純なか:
A mask with a strange mechanism
that keeps its eyes on whoever
looks at it. It should be a simple
trick, yet now and then it gives the
illusion of glancing away in
boredom.
傘から水滴が降り注ぐ不思議な茸。\n群生地の湿度を保つことで\n菌の成長を促して:
A strange mushroom that rains
droplets from its cap. By keeping
its colony humid it promotes the
growth of its fungus, and the
fairer the weather, the stronger
the flow.
開花した花弁が風を受けると、\n小鳥を惹きつける甘い蜜を出す。\n鳥類を花粉媒介:
When its open petals catch the wind
it gives sweet nectar that draws
small birds. A white flower that uses
birds as pollinators. Since birds
land on it, its stem is thick and
its blooms large, hiding the nectar.
水平な場所に設置し太陽光を\n当てると、反射光が常に南を示す\nという不思議な赤:
A strange red gem that, placed on
level ground in sunlight, always
reflects light to the south. Useless
at night, but it is pretty and
unbreakable, so it was worn as
jewelry.
多孔質の鉱石で、触媒として働き\n周囲の匂いを強くする。\n人の嗅覚で感じられな:
A porous ore that acts as a catalyst
and strengthens nearby smells.
Because scents humans cannot detect
become smellable, it is hoped it
will lead to gear replacing a dog's
nose.
≪反魂せし翠狼≫がまとうとされる\n生命を奪う虫\n熱量を直接奪い、餌とする習性:
A bug said to cling to the Risen
Emerald Wolf, taking life. It has a
habit of directly draining heat as
food, and is said to keep that heat
stored in physical form.
ラブラウ島で確認された新種の鳥竜種。\n他の島の海岸に打ち上げられる骨から、\n:
A new bird wyvern species confirmed
on Labrau Island. Bones washed up on
other islands' shores had predicted
its existence. Thought to be a
mutation of Jaggi. Its throat sac
mucus robs prey of freedom.
青い光を放つ美しい結晶\n発光の仕組みなど分っていないが、\n結晶の側にいる生物:
A beautiful crystal that gives off
blue light. How it emits light is
unknown, but the strength of nearby
creatures activity is thought to
match the light strength.
感応結晶をその中心に納めた謎の立方体\n謎の素材で出来ており、感応結晶を劣化\n:
A mysterious cube holding a
resonance crystal at its center.
Made of an unknown material, it is
thought to protect the crystal from
decay, but what it is used for
a-waits study.
イシルルタ島の古の祭壇で発見された\n青い色をした六面の封石。\nラブラウ島の封:
A blue six-faced seal stone found
at the ancient altar of Isilruta
Island. Its shape and weight are
almost identical to the Labrau seal
stone, and its function is confirmed
to be running.
衝撃で電気を発する鉱石を投げ易い\n大きさの八面体に加工した石。\n落下衝突時に:
An ore that emits electricity on
impact, cut to a throwable
octahedron. On landing it discharges
from six points, a sight used in
ancient rituals.
睡眠を誘う芳香が仕込まれた仮面。\n人に仮面を外して貰わない限り眠り\n続け、そ:
A mask laced with a fragrance that
induces sleep. Unless another person
removes it, the wearer sleeps on and
dreams nightmares all the while.
Thought to have been used in ancient
punishment.
ゆらゆらと飛ぶ姿が陽炎の中を\n飛んでいるように見える虫。\n砂漠に生息しており:
A bug whose drifting flight makes it
look like it dances in a heat haze.
It lives in the desert, and seeing
it fly over the sand makes you feel
hot even when cold.
被りものタイプの仮面で、左右の\n側面と後頭部の三方に、笑顔の面が\n付いている:
A pull-on mask with smiling faces on
the sides and the back of the head.
The smiles catch the eye even from
some distance, so it is said street
vendors used it.
火山から噴出されて海に落ちた\n浮石のうち、島周辺の渦に囚われ\n何年も波間に漂:
A stone flung out by a volcano and
fallen into the sea, caught in the
island whirlpools and drifting for
years. By the time it washes ashore
it is often plate-shaped.
鉱石を食べるため、爪が強靭な\nハンマーと化したロブスター。\n固いものを見ると:
A lobster whose claws have become
stout hammers because it eats ore.
Seeing something hard, it tries to
smash it at random, even breaking
the nests and shells of unrelated
creatures.
光砂を固めて作られた装身具。\n白いすりガラスの様に見えるが\n太陽光の下では見:
An ornament made by hardening
luminous sand. It looks like white
frosted glass, but under sunlight it
shows six colors by the viewing
angle. A plant turning red is carved
on it.
他の大型魚の腹にくっ付いて\n寄生するカワハギ科の小魚。\nやがて皮膚を同化させ:
A small filefish that clings to the
belly of another large fish as a
parasite. It eventually fuses skin
with its host, but keeps its
camouflage, so it can appear on the
host's belly.
古代、火山の観測用に使われた石窟。\n岩壁を切り出した多数の穴を覗くと\n火口の:
A rock chamber used in ancient times
to observe a volcano. Peering into
the many holes cut in the rock wall
reveals the crater and other points.
When sunset enters the mouth, light
leaking from the holes makes a
strange sight.
敵に襲われると口から出る液体を\nまき散らしながら逃げるヤモリ。\nしかし、自分:
A gecko that flees scattering the
liquid from its mouth when attacked.
It seems to get drunk on its own
liquid, for after a while it staggers
as it runs.
その鱗粉に発火物質を含んだ蝶。\n襲われると鱗粉が発火し、\n火の粉となって周辺:
A butterfly whose scales contain an
igniting substance. When attacked the
scales ignite and scatter as sparks.
In mating season males are said to
scatter sparks to court females.
うず高く積み上げられた祭壇の遺跡。\n水害で祭壇が水没する度、新しい祭壇が\nそ:
Ruins of an altar piled high. Each
time flooding submerged the altar, a
new one was built on its rubble,
until at last it no longer sank.
Studying the rubble makes it a
valuable historic site.
発見された３つ目の封石は、頑丈な\n外枠が緑がかった素材で出来ている。\n先住民:
The third seal stone found, its
sturdy frame made of a greenish
material. Native ruins are said to
have described seal stones, but no
report yet reveals its origin or
purpose.
セベクル島で発見された４つ目の封石で\n外枠には白く固い素材が使われている。\n:
The fourth seal stone, found on
Sebekuru Island, its frame made of a
hard white material. Study of ruins
suggests a significant link with the
mysterious winged monster.
甲殻に弱い磁気を持つ黄金虫の仲間。\n稀に発生する鳥の飛行時激突事故は\nマグネ:
A scarab beetle with weak magnetism
in its shell. Rare mid-air bird
collisions are thought to happen
because the magnetism upsets the
sense of direction of birds that eat
it.
砂漠の砂中に見られるサボテンの\n様な丸石。岩が砂との摩擦で削れて\n丸くなった:
A round stone like a cactus, seen in
desert sand. It is thought to have
been worn round by friction with the
sand. The cause is said to be the
tiny tremors the desert keeps up over
long ages.
巻貝の殻を好むヤドカリの一種で、\n高熱を発し蒸気を作り出す。\n敵に襲われると:
A kind of hermit crab that favors
spiral shells and produces great heat
and steam. When attacked, it fires
the shell with steam pressure, with
enough force to drop a flying bird.
冬山に生える茸で、動物が倒れた\n後に暫くして生えだす。\n傘は目立たず軸が灰色:
A mushroom that grows on winter
mountains, appearing some time after
an animal falls. Its cap is modest,
its stem a gray cylinder, and several
grow at even spacing, like tiny
fairy gravestones.
砂漠に流れる川辺に生えるイチゴ。\n砂地に安定するようにツルが\nうねうねと砂を:
A strawberry growing by a river in
the desert. To stay stable in the
sand, its vines wriggle and grip the
ground. The fruit too is long and
wriggly, like a red earthworm, and
birds love it.
大きな宝石の中にある空洞が\n柔らかく熟した果実の様に見える。\n表面に豊穣を意:
A cavity inside a large gem looks
like soft, ripe fruit. Carved on its
surface are letters meaning
abundance, which even in ancient
times are thought to have suggested
fruit.
環境色に合わせた花粉を生成する花。\n花粉を運ぶ媒体となる虫の体を\n環境色の花:
A flower that makes pollen matching
its surroundings. By dyeing the body
of the insects that carry it with
environment-colored pollen, it gives
them temporary camouflage so the
pollen travels safely.
山岳地帯の雪解け水が伏流水となり\n砂漠地帯を流れる川に噴出。地下を\n流れた水:
Meltwater from the mountains seeps
underground and bursts into a river
crossing the desert. The underflow
carries phosphorescent stone that
settles on the riverbed. At night
the middle reaches become a river of
light.
素手で触り続けるとヒリヒリした\n痛みを感じる石。古代においては\nモンスターが:
A stone that stings with pain if you
keep touching it with bare hands. In
ancient times it was used as a wall
to keep monsters away. Sprinkling
water is said to strengthen it.
静かな池のような砂だまりに\n朝と夕の横からの日差しで\n非常に細微な砂の紋が観:
On a still pool of sand, the low
morning and evening sunlight reveals
very fine ripples. Their patterns
show a solemn, quiet rhythm that
brings a requiem to mind.
頑丈な鎖で繋がれた一対の足枷だが\nその表面には、高い技法で\n美しい花模様が施:
A pair of shackles joined by a
sturdy chain, their surface worked
with beautiful flower patterns by a
high craft. They are thought to have
been used not for punishment but as
ritual tools.
木の洞を利用し人面に意匠した\n仮面で森の精霊がイメージされる。\n群島先住民の:
A mask shaped into a human face
using a tree hollow, evoking a
forest spirit. Among the island
natives' nature faith, it is imagined
they held a belief that people and
trees are reborn into each other.
回収時より発光に不安定な挙動を\n見せていた紅六面の封石は、外枠に\n小さな亀裂:
The crimson seal stone had shown
unstable glowing since recovery, and
a small crack was found in its
frame. Repair is deemed impossible,
so it now rests in a shock-absorbing
case.
砂漠に棲む昆虫だが砂に潜るのが苦手。\nその代わり、日差しや外敵から\n身を守る:
An insect of the desert, but poor at
burrowing into sand. Instead, to
shield itself from sun and foes, it
plasters leaves and thorns all over
its body. Its look is less mimicry
than armament.
精強で最大級の体長を持つ個体。\n群島でのジャギィノスの大型化は\nドスジャギィ:
A strong individual of the largest
size. The growing size of island
Jagginos is thought to be because
Great Jaggi numbers fall short from
turf wars with Apypos.
海沿い岸壁に立ち並ぶ白い像の群。\n実際は砂浜の塩分が海風に乗り\n吹き溜まりに:
A row of white statues along a
coastal cliff. In truth it is a
natural phenomenon: salt from the
beach rides the sea wind and clings
to dead trees in a drift. It can
look like shipwreck survivors
begging for help.
体色を赤色から黄色まで連続して\n変化させることで、燃え上がって\nいる炎の動き:
A lizard that changes its body color
continuously from red to yellow,
mimicking even the motion of rising
flame. While mimicking fire its body
temperature spikes, as if it recreates
even the heat.
ヤドカリが好む貝殻に擬態するタコ。\n胴部を砂に埋め、足を巻くと\n海底に転がっ:
An octopus that mimics the shells
hermit crabs like. It buries its
body in sand and curls its legs, so
it looks like a shell lying on the
seabed. It eats the hermit crabs
that come to move in.
火山中腹に施設された古代の坂道。\n意図的に錯視が起こる様に作られ\n上り坂が下:
An ancient road built on a volcano's
flank. It is made to cause an
optical illusion, so an uphill looks
like a downhill. A setup of giant
rock and ash layers even changes the
grade for real.
皮膚から大量の粘液を出して\nスライムのようにどろどろの\n体にすることができる:
A frog that can turn its body to
slime by releasing great amounts of
mucus from its skin. When in danger
it splits off a clump of mucus to
create a decoy identical to itself.
古代の文字が刻まれた宝石群。\nここで栄えていた文明の法典が\n宝石に刻まれて残:
A group of gems carved with ancient
letters. The code of laws of the
civilization that flourished here was
carved into gems and left behind.
Better preserved than documents, they
are thought used in ceremonies.
尻尾を自ら切って逃げるトカゲに\n類するが、尻尾の他に四肢も\n切り離すことが出:
Akin to lizards that shed their
tails to flee, it can detach limbs
besides its tail. Its body has ten
points where it can self-amputate,
giving it a high ability to escape
danger.
乾燥肉で作られ食べられる壺。\n発掘時点では、さすがに食べる\nことは出来ないが:
A pot made of dried meat and meant
to be eaten. At the time of
excavation it could not, of course,
be eaten, but excellent preservation
kept it intact. It is thought to
have been used at banquets.
叩く度もくもくと煙が上がる太鼓。\n長時間、大量の煙を出し続け\n地域一帯が煙で:
A drum that belches smoke whenever
struck. It sends out great quantities
of smoke for a long time, filling
the whole area. It was used in rain
rites, but must have been very
smoky.
荒野のただ中で赤々と燃え盛る湖。\n地底から湧き続ける天然燃料で湖が\n満たされ:
A lake burning red in the middle of
the wild. Natural fuel welling up
from below fills the lake and
spontaneously ignites. Warm though
it looks in a cold region, the
burning stench keeps everyone away.
鋭利な羽で近寄る敵すべてを切り裂く蝶。\n若い蝶はうかつに近付けないほど\n周囲:
A butterfly that slashes everything
that comes near with sharp wings.
Young ones wound their surroundings
so much that none dare approach, but
in time they grow calm, as if they
understood something.
普通の魚に見えるが、敵に襲われると\n三枚におろしたような姿に分かれて\n逃げる:
Looks like an ordinary fish, but
when attacked it splits into a
three-fillet form and flees. The
upper, bone-middle and lower piece
cannot change back after growing, and
once parted, finding each other is
hard.
中心部が等速で回転している球状の宝石。\n光を当てると細かく反射した光が辺りを\:
A spherical gem whose core spins at
constant speed. When light strikes
it, fine reflections light the
surroundings and make you want to
dance. It seems used in ritual
dances.
割れる時に轟音を上げる不思議な石。\n大きければ大きいほど割れた時の音量も\n大:
A strange stone that roars when it
splits. The bigger it is, the louder
the crack. About the giant boulder
found this time, the Guild seems
split on whether to break it or not.
古代文明遺跡群は感応結晶を人工的に\n造り出す為の巨大装置であった。\n暗六面の:
The ancient civilization ruins were
a giant device for making resonance
crystals by hand. The dark seal
stone is confirmed to be the one
that controls the device, and it
looks unlike the others.
綿毛を飛ばす白い花の大群生地で\n見られる現象。雨上がりの後\nからっと晴れた日:
A phenomenon seen where a great
colony of white fluff-bearing
flowers grows. After rain, on a
crisp clear day, the fluff may all
fly at once. Though fair, the
landscape looks like white mist.
蝶の仲間だがほとんど羽ばたかない。\n群島の海風を利用して、木の葉が\n舞い散る:
A butterfly, but one that barely
flaps. It rides the archipelago sea
wind and moves as if leaves scatter.
It can fly that way even in still
air, so birds do not see it as
prey.
粉状のものに止血作用があり傷口に\n振りまいて使う。薬屋で煉瓦の様に\n焼き固め:
The powder has a styptic effect and
is sprinkled on wounds. It seems
drug shops sold it baked hard like
brick. Wounds heal somewhat faster,
but the itch while healing is
strong.
昼間は砂漠の砂に潜んでいるが\n月の明るい夜に砂上に出てくる。\n雄はラメ入り粘:
It hides in desert sand by day but
comes out on bright moonlit nights.
Males coat their skin with a
shimmering mucus and dance over the
sand, reflecting the moonlight to
court females.
宝石のルビーで作られた知恵の輪。\n高い技術で宝石がパズルとして\n加工されてい:
A puzzle ring made of ruby. Gems are
worked into a puzzle by high craft.
The puzzle is difficult and genuine,
and selected people are said to have
performed it as an offering feat.
岩場に囲まれた温泉の上に夕日が\n浮かんで見える現象。岩に開いた小さな\n穴と、:
A phenomenon in which the setting
sun appears floating above a hot
spring ringed by rocks. The small
holes in the rock and the sun setting
position project a scene of the sun
sinking at the horizon onto white
steam.
鐘の音のような鳴き声のバッタ。\n古代には神聖な生き物として崇められ\n神官によ:
A grasshopper whose cry sounds like
a bell. In ancient times it was
worshipped as a sacred creature and
kept by priests. Rites are said to
have begun when the altar's
grasshopper started to sing.
発見されたのは砂の仮面を作る型。\n埋葬に使われる仮面で、砂を樹脂で\n固めて穏:
What was found is a mold for making
sand masks. A mask used in burial, it
sets sand with resin to reproduce a
gentle expression. Several body molds
were also found, and their design
suggests tribute to a warrior.
異様に長く丈夫な腹ビレを持つ魚。\nその腹ビレの先を海底に固定して\n何もない海:
A fish with an oddly long, tough
pelvic fin. It anchors the tip of the
fin to the seafloor so it can stay
in empty water. It looks like a
standing sign, and is actually used
as a marker by divers.
貝殻が入れ子状の二枚貝の仲間。\nある程度の大きさになると貝殻が\n２重になる。:
A kind of bivalve whose shells nest.
After growing to a certain size it
gains a double shell. When bitten by
a fish, it can abandon the outer
shell and escape. Some long-lived
ones have five shells.
表面からこんこんと水が湧き出す石。\n多孔性の石の中でも、穴の大きさが\nかなり:
A stone from whose surface water
bubbles up. Among porous stones, its
pores are very fine and tube-like.
If the stone base is in water,
capillary action makes water well up
from the top.
大螺旋階段の構造が美しい井戸。\n岩場にある泉の周囲を長年かけて\n掘り進めるう:
A well with a beautiful great spiral
staircase. As the spring on the rocky
ground was dug out over the years, a
lovely spiral stair took shape into
a mysterious space.
砂漠に生息する角を持つ大型甲虫。\n砂上で見られる白い角のある姿は\nモンスター:
A large horned beetle of the desert.
Its white horned form on the sand
looks like the broken-off tip of a
monster fang or claw. The horn tip
is as sharp and dangerous as the
real thing.
可食部は少ないが、大変美味である。\n特に傘の部分には旨味が豊富で\n中毒性が高:
Little of it is edible, but it is
delicious. The cap especially is rich
in umami and highly addictive, so
everyone who eats it says with one
voice: just one more! and eats
several.
背中に黒曜石を含有する鱗がある貴重なトカゲ。\n含まれる黒曜石の量が少ないため\:
A rare lizard with obsidian-bearing
scales on its back. Because it holds
little obsidian, it is unfit for
weapon work, but since long ago it
has been used in necklaces and as a
charm.
